svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outside: 150 mm across at the rim, 104 mm across the crown, 22 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tall, 6 mm radius round the crown edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: a cone 142 mm across at the rim and 96 mm at the top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm deep, so the crown is 4 mm thick and the rim face is a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cast in the silicone mould with the core plug (step 2): mix about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 95 g of resin with yellow pigment, pour it into the cavity, press

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the core plug down until its flange sits on the block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Demould after the maker's time; post-cure as the data sheet says.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Trim the flash at the rim with a knife; keep the rim face flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the rim sits flat on the base tray, over its locating ring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 22 mm tall outside and 18 mm deep inside (so the crown

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is 4 mm), no bubbles in the crown, rim flat on a glass plate.
